UserRecord.title: User Record
UserRecord.description: A record representing a user's data associated with their mobile number.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number (unique identifier for lookup).

details.description: Additional details from the Excel file.

isEligible.description: Whether the user has been marked as eligible.

markedAt.description: When the user was marked as eligible.

markedBy.description: The UID of the user who marked this record.

UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: A profile for an authenticated user, storing their role.

role.description: The user's role in the application.

/records/{recordId}.description: Collection of all user records, searchable by mobile number.

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of user profiles for role-based access control.
